title: Carne Asada
description: Skirt steak marinated in citrus, garlic, and cumin, then seared hard and fast over high heat and sliced against the grain — the marinade tenderizes, the fire does the rest.

image.alt: Raw seasoned steak with rosemary and salt on a dark cutting board

steps: Whisk the orange juice, lime juice, olive oil, garlic, jalapeño, cumin, salt, and pepper together.
Place the steak in a shallow dish, pour the marinade over, and turn to coat. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, up to overnight.
Remove the steak from the fridge 30 minutes before cooking. Heat a grill or heavy skillet until very hot, then shake excess marinade off the steak.
Sear the steak 3–4 minutes per side for medium-rare — skirt steak is thin, so watch it closely.
Rest the steak 5–10 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain.
Scatter with cilantro and serve with warm tortillas.
note: Slicing against the grain is not optional — skirt steak has long, visible muscle fibers that turn chewy if cut the wrong way.
